The hash is sha256 of that resulting UTF-8 string's hex digest.
regenerate: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');const crypto=require('crypto');const src=execFileSync('git',['show','9d5ec9197d22d844dfa5be8a6b81f0b9796dd17d:partner-agreement.html'],{encoding:'utf8'});function visibleText(h){return h.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g,' ').replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/’/g,'\u2019').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,'\u2019').replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/\s+([,;.:!?])/g,'$1').trim();}function stripVersionLabel(t){return t.replace(/Effective Date:\s*[A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}/,'').replace(/Version:\s*v\d+-\d{4}-\d{2}/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}console.log(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(stripVersionLabel(visibleText(src)),'utf8').digest('hex'));" -- run from the repo root with that commit reachable in the local clone.
